The report names Rabbi Yaakov bar Aḥa and Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, and gives the twenty-four-month ruling.
Rabbi Yirmeyah’s report in the exact Yerushalmi parallel explicitly reads לרבי חנינא. The proposed revision resolves the English against that witness and leaves Heilprin’s Hebrew abbreviation intact.
